name: omni-space-and-slo-coverage-auditor
description: Audits CloudWatch Omni coverage: which discovered applications/services belong to an Omni Space with declared service-health targets (availability, latency budget, error rate) versus which are discovered but unowned or target-less. Cross-checks Application Signals SLOs and CloudWatch alarms to separate true blind spots from consolidation gaps. Read-only and recommend-only; relies on CloudWatch-native reads plus surfaced Omni context (no assumed Omni API) and recommends a CloudWatch/Omni MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 09:00 UTC
